questions.explanation: Given data: [latex] \begin{aligned} \Delta h &=-0.8 \mathrm{kJ} / \mathrm{kg} \\ h_{2}-h_{1} &=-0.8 \mathrm{kJ} / \mathrm{kg} \\ h_{1}-h_{2} &=0.8 \mathrm{kJ} / \mathrm{kg} \end{aligned}[/latex] Applying steady flow energy equation, [latex] h_{1}+\frac{V_{1}^{2}}{2}+g z_{1}+q=h_{2}+\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2}+g z_{2}+w[/latex] Assumptions: (i) q=0 adiabatic flow (ii) w=0 (iii) Change k.E. and P.E. are neglect (iv) Neglect inlet velocity. [latex] \begin{aligned} \therefore \quad h_{1} &=h_{2}+\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2} \\ h_{1} &=h_{2}+\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2000} \\ h_{1}-h_{2} &=\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2000} \\ \text{or}\qquad 8 &=\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2000} \\ V_{2}^{2} &=1600 \\ \text{or}\qquad V_{2} &=40 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s} \end{aligned}[/latex]

[latex] \begin{aligned} \Delta h &=-0.8 \mathrm{kJ} / \mathrm{kg} \\ h_{2}-h_{1} &=-0.8 \mathrm{kJ} / \mathrm{kg} \\ h_{1}-h_{2} &=0.8 \mathrm{kJ} / \mathrm{kg} \end{aligned}[/latex]
Applying steady flow energy equation,
[latex] h_{1}+\frac{V_{1}^{2}}{2}+g z_{1}+q=h_{2}+\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2}+g z_{2}+w[/latex]
Assumptions:
(i) q=0 adiabatic flow
(ii) w=0
(iii) Change k.E. and P.E. are neglect
(iv) Neglect inlet velocity.
[latex] \begin{aligned} \therefore \quad h_{1} &=h_{2}+\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2} \\ h_{1} &=h_{2}+\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2000} \\ h_{1}-h_{2} &=\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2000} \\ \text{or}\qquad 8 &=\frac{V_{2}^{2}}{2000} \\ V_{2}^{2} &=1600 \\ \text{or}\qquad V_{2} &=40 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s} \end{aligned}[/latex]
